title: FarmHelperEasy
description: The mod adds the ability to obtain bone meal more easily using grass and flowers.
body:
This mod allows you to obtain bone meal more easily, namely with the help of grass and flowers. The mod adds a 10% chance of dry grass dropping from short grass and a 20% chance of dry grass dropping from long grass. Also, if you combine 3 flowers in a workbench, you will get dry flowers. Below is a list of flowers from which you can craft this item.
________________________________

list of flowers:dandelion,poppy,blue orchid,allium,azure bluet,red tulip,orange tulip,white tulip,pink tulip,wither rose,torchflower,lily of the valley,oxeye daisy,cornflower
